ch08.card: Part 7 of 8. Practice, one small nudge at a time.
ch08.s01.c1: Practice sets the numbers inside the thinker (its call writer too), the stop switch (built, not yet run) and the talker (a small stand-in so far).
ch08.s01.c2: The borrowed reader stays frozen. The calculator is plain code, so it needs no practice.
ch08.s02.c2: It is shown the right answer.
ch08.s02.c3: Then every learned setting moves a tiny bit. One nudge is one update.
ch08.s03.c1: Each update looks at 256 practice rows, then nudges every learned setting once.
ch08.s03.c2: The 3M test copy, with 3.5 million learned settings, did 24,000 updates.
ch08.s03.c3: Our multiplication: 24,000 × 256 = 6,144,000 row draws. The pool has 1,418,702 rows, so rows come round again.
ch08.s04.c1: AdamW is the nudging rule. The learning rate is how big a nudge may be.
ch08.s04.c2: It starts small, peaks at 1e-3 after a 300-update warm-up, then falls to 10% of the peak.
ch08.s04.c3: Sums run in short numbers (bf16), rows come shuffled, and the start is random.
ch08.s05.c1: The 3M test copy practised on a pool of 60 million pieces of text (GPT-2 word pieces).
ch08.s05.c2: By word pieces: own text 38%, web text 62%. By rows: own 811,663, web 607,039.
ch08.s05.c3: Our rows: skills questions and English passages made by our code, plus teaching rows (TEACH) a 1.2-billion-number teacher model wrote earlier.
ch08.s06.c1: FineWeb-Edu web text: a script blanks one word of 3 to 12 letters, and the model must name it.
ch08.s06.c2: Each prompt holds at most 280 letters, blank included, in the 3M runs; the finished design's long pool goes up to 2,000.
ch08.s06.c3: It learns to read English, not write it. Rows without steps add a faint no-call label, weight 0.1.
ch08.s07.c1: Where a row has worked steps, the answer key gives the right call each round.
ch08.s07.c2: Call loss: was the call slip right? After the last call, the right slip is no call.
ch08.s07.c3: Answer loss: is the final answer right? Counted from the last call round on.
ch08.s08.c1: Teacher forcing: in practice the next round sees the key's call and reply, even after a wrong guess.
ch08.s08.c2: At test time there is no key. The model writes its own calls.
ch08.s08.c3: Not every row has steps: 124,991 of the 200,000 skills rows (62.5%) the earlier 3M models used have none.
ch08.s09.c1: Rule 1: no answer is cut short. A longer answer is counted, and any count above 0 fails the pass mark.
ch08.s09.c2: Rule 2: exam questions are kept apart: 6,040 rows are never used in practice, though question styles can repeat.
ch08.s09.c3: Rule 3: web text is scanned against exam sets. A last scan, on sealed sets, was pending Oct 9; the 3M runs began before it.
ch08.s10.c1: Ours did 24,000 updates on the project's PC: 1.02 updates a second, 6.51 hours.
ch08.s10.c2: The plain model, a standard transformer of about the same size, also did 24,000 updates: 2.8 a second, 2.38 hours.
ch08.s10.c3: Our division: 6.51 ÷ 2.38, about 2.7 times longer. Our other 3M copy took 16.3 hours; a memory spill is the suggested cause.
ch08.s10.c4: A plan, not a result: the 100M run (about 100 million numbers) is estimated at 3 to 5 weeks on this PC.
ch08.s11.c1: The same blocks run every round, so the lesson from a wrong answer must travel back through all of them.
ch08.s11.c2: To save memory, training redoes some work instead of storing it: about a third more compute (plan estimate).
ch08.s11.c3: Depth has a known cost: on one old probe, 16 rounds cost 1.2 to 1.9 points. At 100 million numbers it is an open risk.
ch08.s12.c1: The model's size stays the same. Only the values of its settings change, by many tiny nudges.
ch08.s12.c2: Real before-and-after values are not shown here. This is an idea, drawn as a picture.
ch08.s13.c1: Practice is a loop: try, check the key, nudge. The 3M test ran 24,000 updates, each looking at 256 rows.
ch08.s13.c2: Rows are questions and passages from our code, teaching rows and web blanks, with exam questions kept apart.
ch08.s13.c3: On one 3M copy ours took about 2.7 times longer than the plain model; the finished design is not trained yet.
